title: Uneraseable - THE FORGOTTEN TRAIL & THE MAD DOCTOR'S LECTURE

critiques.speaker: Alfie
critiques.quote: "What do you reckon would be most useful, mates?" Alfie asked, holding up her glowing timber arm for the table to inspect.
critiques.comment: Why is Alfie holding up a timber arm when we are talking about the chaos belt

critiques.speaker: Alfie
critiques.quote: Alfie blew away a curl of wood dust, admiring the sharp runic buckle etched deep into her wood. "A bit of Wordcraft birthright," she said, her Cockney voice rasping with pride. "Changed *Chaos Bolt* to *Chaos Belt*. Carved it right into my timber so I don't burn an honest reserve of spark when things go sideways. I picture reaching down in the middle of a brawl, pulling out whatever strange device the loom feels like tossing me."
critiques.comment: Chaos belt to chaos belt? I think that's not right

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: Dravin urged patience, lifting a heavy curtain of wild vines with the rim of his shield as the path climbed deeper into the overgrown switchbacks.
critiques.comment: This transaction was very rushed

critiques.speaker: Prof. Edward Dravin
critiques.quote: "Well," Dravin said quietly, exhaling a slow plume of breath into the chill. "That was remarkably prompt. Forward."
critiques.comment: This doesn't really make any sense

critiques.speaker: Alfie
critiques.quote: "University," Alfie repeated from Dravin's shoulder, reading the second half of the wrought-iron archway. "University."
critiques.comment: Repeated

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: At the base of a wide granite stairway, two undergraduate demonstrators stood waving mimeographed pamphlets. One wore an improvised tin-foil band tucked under the brim of his fedora, gesturing frantically at a poster covered in chemical equations.
critiques.comment: I think they were fedora's made of tin foil

critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: "Leave the custodian to French diplomacy, Professor," Pierre murmured, adjusting his wire spectacles with a sudden, predatory glint as his gaze locked onto a cleaning trolley down the colonnade.
critiques.comment: No, this looks too deliberate. Pierre has not really on purpose integrated himself into the plan. He is genuinely trying to understand why this school has such good masonry while still appearing French elite so he's observing the stone and everything he's saying is legitimate concerns he has in draven just so happens to take advantage of these things

critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: Pierre strode purposefully toward the marble alcove where an 18th-century classical bust rested upon a fluted pedestal—directly adjacent to a bulging olive-drab plastic trash bin. Pierre threw his hands into the air, gasping with melodramatic horror. "Sacré bleu! What ungodly barbarism is this? A sculpted masterpiece of Hellenic beauty, shoved behind a municipal garbage receptacle! And there is pigeon filth upon the brow! Where is the barbarian responsible for this desecration?"
critiques.comment: Given my previous comment, a better transition would be the people talking to the tin foil hat look over and draven starts looking around for staff only to catch eyes on Pierre who's examining a sculpture and has the look of outrage on his face while he too locks on to the janitor and seeing a Parisian fit was on the way draven made his move

critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: "Prove it to me, Monsieur Ready!" Pierre challenged, gesturing imperiously toward the academic quad. "Where is your studio? Show me this so-called sculpture hall! Lead the way!"
critiques.comment: There was a lot of lost dialogue here with Pierre and Rick going back and forth and Rick saying it's not his department

critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: "The alien enthusiasts have colonized the university," Pierre muttered under his breath, nudging his wire spectacles higher. "In France, our conspiracists prefer wine and philosophy. In America, they wear baked potato wrapping."
critiques.comment: In the America they wear baked potato wrapping shaped in rather nice hats. I must say pointing to the Fedora shape

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: Dravin smoothed his rumpled tweed lapels, thumbed his tarnished pocket bell, and strode directly down the central aisle toward the illuminated stage with the effortless authority of a tenured department chair. Alfie sat proudly upon his shoulder, her oversized museum ballcap tilted back so her seashell eyes could scan the crowd for University University caps. Reaching the mahogany lectern, Dravin tapped the brass gooseneck receiver to silence the room.
critiques.comment: This is very rushed. There's a whole bunch of things that happen here for the professor to take advantage of the chaos and try to insert himself as if he was faculty here. We need a better bridge

critiques.speaker: Museum Attendant
critiques.quote: "What? What's up?" the student squeaked, shrinking back against his chair.
critiques.comment: This isn't the museum attendant. This is the faculty who was going to introduce the speaker, but the combination of draven's decisive action and Piers coincidental pestering again draven taking advantage of Pierre being obsessed about finding faculty to tell him where the sculpture department is

critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: "Professor," Pierre murmured in a conspiratorial whisper, his spectacles glinting beneath the house lights, "is it customary for American faculties to be utterly clueless regarding their finest artistic ateliers?"
critiques.comment: We missed a bridge here because what happened is the professor and Alfie snuck out and were trying to be stealthy but Pierre made a huge ruckus so draven pretended he was faculty and sent Pierre back into the lecture who then did so and sat next to the attendant who was previously just a second ago relieved he was no longer there

critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: Behind him in the queue, Pierre popped his head up over Eusacles’s broad shoulder. "But you don't know where the sculpture class is."
critiques.comment: Good comedic break but doesn't really fit the transition here so maybe let's rethink how we do that

critiques.speaker: Eusacles
critiques.quote: From the rear double doors, a sudden commotion rattled the hall. A man wearing a trench coat and a tin-foil fedora thrust his head through the crack, yelling at the top of his lungs: *"This guy gets it!"* before campus security grappled him back out into the rain. A murmur of intense curiosity rippled across the student body. Several faculty members in the front row began nodding their heads.
critiques.comment: Formatting issue here and technically a different speaker

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: Dravin glanced down at Alfie. Alfie looked back up, his carved wooden jaw tightening beneath his canvas ballcap.
critiques.comment: I like this transition but it's not quite right because draven didn't really ask permission. He just grabbed Alfie around his waist and in that slow section of time between being planted into the binder. Alfie muttered himself not again why me not again or whatever he said before being squished into it by draven

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: The auditorium did not fade; it shattered. The overhead chandeliers flared in a violent strobe of violet lightning, and instantly the four companions were ripped from the hall and plunged into a claustrophobic subterranean darkness.
critiques.comment: This would be a good place to put one of those dashes or some sort of visual break as we go into a different scene

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: ***STALE.***
critiques.comment: This is a triple* which might be fine and what we intended to do here, but let's follow general conventions which means no markdown or anything like that for a book

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: The Margin had arrived for the binder.
critiques.comment: The reductors had arrived

critiques.speaker: Prof. Edward Dravin
critiques.quote: "Sorry, Alfie," Dravin breathed, scooping the wooden duelist and the heavy anomaly binder into his arms and rising to his feet as the cloaked beasts surged forward.
critiques.comment: Draven says this right before he had smushed Alfie into the binder, so several things happened all at once. Professor opened the binder. The enemies revealed themselves ready to pounce springing their trap, but it was already somewhat too late for them because draven had already smushed Alfie into the tablet triggering the vision. I think we should reorder them to be like that
